Name: Dayz Server Monitor
Description: Independent DayZ server monitor companion: restart countdown, players, history, UDP RTT and estimated in-game clock. Requires the Windows monitor app.
Author: Iron-panda666

Actions.Name: Cycle server information
Actions.Tooltip: Press to cycle views. Hold for one second to request a refresh with the monitor's shared 20-second limit.

Actions.Name: Pinned server information
Actions.Tooltip: Keep one view on this key. Hold for one second to request a refresh. A short press does not send a query.
